mapper.sql: select id, archive_code, resident_name, gender, age, birth_date, id_card, phone, address, community, archive_date, archive_status, managing_institution, managing_doctor, disease_types, archive_source, transfer_in_date, is_signed, family_history, allergy_history, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from resident_archive
mapper.select:
and resident_name like concat('%', #{residentName}, '%') and id_card like concat('%', #{idCard}, '%') and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and disease_types like concat('%', #{diseaseTypes}, '%') and archive_status = #{archiveStatus} and managing_institution like concat('%', #{managingInstitution}, '%') and is_signed = #{isSigned}
order by id desc
select count(distinct mp.card_id) from mp_person mp inner join resident_archive ra on mp.card_id = ra.id_card where ra.archive_status = '0'
select count(distinct mp.card_id) from mp_person mp inner join resident_archive ra on mp.card_id = ra.id_card where to_char(ra.create_time, 'YYYY-MM') = to_char(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM')
select count(distinct mp.card_id) from mp_person mp inner join resident_archive ra on mp.card_id = ra.id_card where ra.archive_source = '3'

select count(distinct mp.card_id) from mp_person mp inner join resident_archive ra on mp.card_id = ra.id_card where ra.archive_status = '0' and ra.managing_institution is not null and ra.managing_institution != '' and ra.managing_doctor is not null and ra.managing_doctor != '' and ra.disease_types is not null and ra.disease_types != ''

select ra.disease_types as name, count(distinct mp.card_id) as value from mp_person mp inner join resident_archive ra on mp.card_id = ra.id_card where ra.disease_types is not null and ra.disease_types != '' group by ra.disease_types order by value desc
mapper.sql: select mp.person_id, mp.person_name, mp.gender_source_value, mp.card_id, mp.card_type, mp.phone_number, mp.location_id, mp.address as mp_address, mp.contacts_name, mp.contacts_phone, mp.person_career, mp.marital_status, mp.degree_of_education, mp.sex, mp.create_time as mp_create_time, mp.update_time as mp_update_time, ra.id as ra_id, ra.archive_code, ra.age, ra.birth_date, ra.disease_types, ra.archive_date, ra.archive_status, ra.managing_institution, ra.managing_doctor, ra.archive_source, ra.transfer_in_date, ra.is_signed, ra.family_history, ra.allergy_history, ra.community, ra.remark
from ( select card_id, max(person_id) as person_id from mp_person group by card_id ) m join mp_person mp on mp.person_id = m.person_id left join resident_archive ra on ra.id_card = m.card_id
mapper.select:
( CASE WHEN ra.disease_types LIKE '%高血压%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ra.disease_types LIKE '%糖尿病%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ra.disease_types LIKE '%脑卒中%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ra.disease_types LIKE '%冠心病%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ra.disease_types LIKE '%慢阻肺%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) >= 2 and mp.person_name like concat('%', #{personName}, '%') and mp.card_id = #{cardId}
order by mp.create_time desc

select ra.managing_institution as institutionName, count(distinct mp.card_id) as totalArchives, sum(case when to_char(ra.create_time, 'YYYY-MM') = to_char(now(), 'YYYY-MM') then 1 else 0 end) as newThisMonth, sum(case when ra.disease_types like '%高血压%' then 1 else 0 end) as hypertension, sum(case when ra.disease_types like '%糖尿病%' then 1 else 0 end) as diabetes, sum(case when ra.disease_types like '%脑卒中%' then 1 else 0 end) as stroke, sum(case when ra.disease_types like '%冠心病%' then 1 else 0 end) as chd, sum(case when ra.disease_types like '%慢阻肺%' then 1 else 0 end) as copd from ( select card_id, max(person_id) as person_id from mp_person group by card_id ) m join mp_person mp on mp.person_id = m.person_id inner join resident_archive ra on ra.id_card = m.card_id where ra.managing_institution is not null and ra.managing_institution != '' group by ra.managing_institution order by totalArchives desc
mapper.insert: insert into resident_archive (archive_code, resident_name, gender, age, birth_date, id_card, phone, address, community, archive_date, archive_status, managing_institution, managing_doctor, disease_types, archive_source, transfer_in_date, is_signed, family_history, allergy_history, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{archiveCode}, #{residentName}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{birthDate}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{community}, #{archiveDate}, #{archiveStatus}, #{managingInstitution}, #{managingDoctor}, #{diseaseTypes}, #{archiveSource}, #{transferInDate}, #{isSigned}, #{familyHistory}, #{allergyHistory}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from resident_archive where id in #{id}
